text:
Mika S: Heads up: Caltrain showing delays of 25-40 mins due to signal issues near Millbrae. Just got the alert. https://caltrain.example/status :train2:
Harper G: Oof. I was about to catch the 8:02. Guess I'll jump on the 8:35 or take the bus.
Nolan P: If anyone's driving, 3rd St is backed up because of a multi-car spinout by the waterfront. Took me an extra 20.
Dana R: Ferry F5 is still running but on reduced speed because of chop. Might be slower but at least not canceled.
TransitBot: Service notice: Caltrain delays 20-45 minutes due to signal trouble. Bus 10 running with detours; allow extra travel time.
WeatherBot: Coastal wind advisory active until 11:30. Visibility variable with sea spray. Recommend secure loose items and avoid bike with cargo.
Mika S: Parking heads-up: the garage attendants say the lower level is closed for pump maintenance. Use street or the overflow lot.
Harper G: Can anyone pick up milk? The tiny cartons are gone. I'll Venmo.
KitchenBot: Milk stock: 0 small cartons, 3 large. Coffee: medium. ETA resupply 12:00.
Nolan P: @Harper G I can grab milk on the way in, leaving now. Also bringing a spare umbrella to leave at Reception.
Dana R: Meme: "Caltrain: where 'on time' is a suggestion" (posted GIF) :joy:
Harper G: Thanks Nolan! If the train is really bad I'll hop in with you.
Mika S: Quick poll: standup at 10 — in person or remote? Reply with "in" or "remote".
Nolan P: in (might be 5-10 late)
Dana R: remote (watching the commute chaos)
Harper G: remote (depends on whether Caltrain gods are merciful)
TransitBot: Update: Caltrain technicians on scene. Next status update expected in 20 minutes.
Mika S: I'll keep this thread updated if the lower garage reopens or if any routes change. Safe travels and watch for spray on the promenade. :thumbsup:
